sketch:
Observe: R-L-C série (or parallel) montage; sliders on R, L, C.
Bode plot has a peak at f_0 = 1/(2π√LC) with bandwidth set by
Q = L·ω_0/R. Two cut-offs f_1, f_2 flank the peak. A phasor gadget
shows Z(jω) sweeping. Experiment: hit a target (f_0, Δf) — student
picks L·C for f_0, then R for Δf. Evaluate: from a Bode plot pick
the (L, C, R) triple. Wrinkle: resonance / réactance sign flips at
f_0 — inductive above, capacitive below.
